column1: # Lazy agent launchers for the AI layer.
# The installer generates one stub script per row. Nothing is downloaded at
# install time - mise resolves and caches the package the first time the stub
# is invoked, so shipping several costs nothing but a few hundred bytes each.
# Only tools Arch does NOT package. Anything in the official repositories goes
# in manifest/core.packages instead, where it gets pacman's signature checks
# and updates - that is why the GitHub CLI is not here (D18).
# Every spec below was verified against the npm registry on 2026-09-07,
# including that the package actually declares the executable named in the
# third field. pi is absent because it declares none (D17).
